title: Centers & outsource labs
seo_description: Multi-center lab management: run branches, collection centers, and partner labs in one system, switch between centers, and compare activity and revenue.

fields.hero_title: Every branch, collection center, and partner lab in one system
fields.hero_lead: Branches, collection centers, and home collection run in one system. Switch between centers, compare activity and revenue across all of them, and keep partner and B2B work on the same record.
fields.features:
Switch between centers in one click
Compare activity across every center
Revenue by day and by center
Home collection and B2B revenue
Dues by patient and partner lab
The same roles and permissions everywhere
